messages:
nina (pm): Quick sync: Vaultly (EU) requested a controlled rollout for the new subscription upsell flow. Must be tenant-gated, include an A/B for conversion and downstream billing validation, and include a low-cost silent-fallback that preserves UX but reduces model tokens. They need per-tenant audit exports and a named on-call for first 48h.

lee (eng): Suggest flag `upsell.flow.v1` with values: off/control/variant. For Vaultly we set override -> variant at 1% then step to 8% if metrics look good. Add `upsell.flow.v1-lite` as silent cheap fallback (quant + caching).

omar (sre): Canary plan: 90m window with 5m buckets. Metrics to watch: p95 latency, 5xx, billing validation mismatch rate, and token burn. Circuit-breaker triggers: error_rate >= 0.4% for 3 buckets OR billing_mismatch_rate > 0.2% for 2 buckets -> auto-toggle to lite fallback. Also enforce per-tenant token cap: soft limit reduces exposure, hard cap forces lite mode.

irene (custops): We'll prepare a runbook with rollback steps, contact list, and a template email for Vaultly. Also they requested audit events in newline-delimited JSON to their S3 path including exact flag_state and model_variant.

lee (eng): Routing snippet for fallback behavior:
```yaml
feature_flag: upsell.flow.v1
routes:
  - match: tenant == "vaultly" && flag_state == "variant"
    action: use: upsell_v1
    on_error: use: upsell_v1-lite
    preserve_session: true
```
This preserves session context while switching to lite mode.

omar (sre): Wire traces with `canary=upsell_v1` and emit metrics per-tenant. Golden-run: run 50 representative billing validation prompts every 15m comparing control vs variant. If validation mismatch > threshold -> rollback.

nina (pm): Acceptance gates after initial 90m: conversion uplift >= +1.8% OR no negative delta beyond -0.5%, p95 latency delta <= +175ms, billing_mismatch_delta <= +0.1%, token burn delta <= +10%. Failure -> immediate rollback + postmortem.

irene (custops): Customer asks for a visible "trial" label during ramp; will check if Vaultly accepts. Also confirm KMS key for S3 export.

lee (eng): Dev tasks: 1) flag + routing rule PR; 2) lite-mode runtime config PR; 3) telemetry + audit export PR. I'll split into PRs and aim to link by 2026-07-12.

omar (sre): Ops tasks: 1) token cap enforcer; 2) circuit-breaker + alerts; 3) webhook to Vaultly ops channel. I'll draft playbook and incident steps.

ops-bot: Pipeline scheduled: `upsell-v1/canary` -> smoke tests -> golden-eval -> scheduled prod canary 2026-07-15 07:00 UTC

nina (pm): Timeline & owners: Lee (eng) PRs by 2026-07-12, Omar (sre) infra + playbook by 2026-07-13, Irene (custops) runbook + customer comms by 2026-07-10. Please react with :white_check_mark: when PRs linked. Closing after owners ack.
